theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_im_pushforward
theorems.statement: (∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ r, IsIntegerMultiplicity (X r)) → ∑' r, (X r).mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), HasSum (fun r => X r ω) (Y ω)) ∧ Y.mass ≤ ∑' r, (X r).mass) → ∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), R.measure univ ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : (Euclid N → Euclid N') → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k, (∀ (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (Λ : NNReal), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsIntegerMultiplicity (Y F) ∧ ∀ Fs : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid N', (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Fs j)) → (∀ j, LipschitzWith Λ (Fs j)) → TendstoUniformly Fs F atTop → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k, Tendsto (fun j => R.action (fun x => ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (Fs j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x))) atTop (𝓝 (Y F ω))) ∧ ∀ (F F' : Euclid N → Euclid N') (Λ : NNReal), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ F' → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[k].restrict R.carrier), F x = F' x) → Y F = Y F'
